question: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?

options.text: Indian Sandalwood – Deciduous forests of Deccan Plateau

solution:
The correct answer is __**Neem - Alpine region**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Neem (Azadirachta indica)** is a tree native to the Indian subcontinent and grows predominantly in tropical and semi-tropical regions.
 
• Neem is well-suited to sub-tropical and tropical regions; it does not thrive in alpine or cold climatic conditions.
 
• Alpine regions are characterized by high altitudes and cold temperatures, which are unsuitable for the growth of Neem trees.
 
• Neem trees are commonly found in dry, arid regions and are known for their drought-resistant properties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Sandalwood (Santalum album)**:

 
 
• Indian Sandalwood is native to the dry deciduous forests of the Deccan Plateau in India.
 
• It is highly valued for its aromatic heartwood and oil, used in perfumes and traditional medicine.
 
 
 
• **Ficus (Ficus species)**:
 
 
• Ficus species, such as the Banyan tree, are common in the Malabar Coast moist forests.
 
• These trees thrive in humid and tropical climates.
 
 
 
• **Pine (Pinus species)**:
 
 
• Pine trees are typically found in the Himalayan subtropical forests.
 
• They are well-adapted to cooler climates and higher altitudes.
 
 
 
• **Alpine Region Characteristics**:
 
 
• Alpine regions are characterized by their high altitude and cold climate.
 
• Vegetation in alpine regions includes hardy shrubs and grasses, with few trees due to harsh conditions.
